title: The four kinds of socialisation
lead: Part 1 covers primary, secondary, formal and informal socialisation, with a short page and a mini-test for each one. The checklist below ticks itself as you pass the mini-tests.

p: Primary and secondary describe when and where you learn. Formal and informal describe how you learn.
list: Primary socialisation is the first stage of learning culture, usually through parents or carers.
Secondary socialisation is the continuing process of learning norms, values and roles beyond the earliest learning in the family.
Formal socialisation is the process where people are deliberately and consciously manipulated to ensure they learn to follow certain rules.
Informal socialisation is the process where people learn to fit into their culture by watching and learning from others around them.
